rows.micah_quote: Summary: Beyond thermodynamics, oscillations in SAN are functional -- they form the computational backbone for communication and integration in the brain. Oscillatory computation means information is encoded in the timing and phase of neural spikes relative to ongoing rhythms. Because many oscillatory cycles can occur in a short window, the brain achieves "time-dense" processing -- performing multiple feedback-adjustment micro-operations within each moment
